title: Blood Donation Camp 2026
details: Annual blood donation camp organized by NSS IIT Patna in collaboration with local hospitals. We successfully collected over 200 units of blood to help patients in need.

title: Village Cleanliness Drive
details: A massive cleanliness drive was organized in the nearby Amhara village under the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan. Over 50 volunteers participated in raising awareness and cleaning the surroundings.

title: Education Outreach Program
details: Weekly education outreach program for the underprivileged children near the campus. Volunteers taught basic science and mathematics concepts through interactive activities.

title: World Environment Day - Tree Plantation
details: Planted 500 saplings across the campus and neighboring areas to promote a greener environment. The event saw participation from students and faculty alike.

title: Yoga and Mental Health Workshop
details: A session focusing on mental well-being, stress relief, and physical fitness through yoga, guided by professional instructors.

title: Computer Literacy Workshop
details: NSS volunteers conducted a basic computer skills and internet safety workshop for children of local government schools.

title: Winter Clothes Distribution Drive
details: NSS IIT Patna organized a donation drive collecting and distributing warm clothes to underprivileged families in nearby areas.
